text:
Add a check that runs before the verifier on jobs that remove text from prompt files and add a docs/decisions.md entry. It lists the removed hunks per prompt file from the candidate diff. It fails, naming the unmatched hunks, unless the new decision entry has a bullet for each hunk that names its file and gives a reason. It also fails if the entry says no test was affected while a check or the athena-context lib tests failed. Acceptance: a test where an entry leaves a removed hunk out fails the check and names the hunk; a test where the entry covers every hunk passes; cargo fmt --check, clippy and the full test suite pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Decision entry for a prompt trim (D166) was rejected twice: it claimed no test was affected, then left removals unlisted and unexplained
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: docs/decisions.md
